framework.name: Strategic Priority 1 - Economic Development and Poverty Reduction
framework.description: By 2021, people in Sudan, with emphasis on small producers and micro-entrepreneurs, have access to improved productive capacities  that contribute to inclusive and sustainable livelihoods, job creation and ending extreme poverty

children.name: Outcome 1.1 By 2021, people in Sudan, with emphasis on small producers and micro-entrepreneurs, have access to improved productive capacities that contribute to inclusive and sustainable livelihoods, job creation and ending extreme poverty
1.1.1 Government institutions have strengthened capacities for evidence-informed policy formulation to promote priority setting and appropriate practices for sustainable economic development
1.1.2. Targeted populations benefit from enriching productive capacities
1.1.3 Rural institutions and businesses are strengthened to promote socio-economic development

framework.name: Strategic Priority 2 - Environment, Climate Resilience and Disaster Risk Management
framework.description: By 2021, people’s resilience to consequences of climate change, environmental stresses and natural hazards is enhanced through strengthened institutions, policies, plans and programmes

children.name: Outcome 2.1 By 2021, people’s resilience to consequences of climate change, environmental stresses and natural hazards is enhanced through strengthened institutions, policies, plans and programmes
2.1.1 Targeted populations are better equipped to withstand climatic shocks, natural disasters and environmental degradation
2.1.2 Institutions have increased capacity to manage and make environment and climate data available
2.1.3 Government institutions have increased capacities to formulate environmental policies, plans and strategies

framework.name: Strategic Priority 3 - Social Services
framework.description: By 2021, the populations in vulnerable situations have improved health, nutrition, education, water and sanitation, and social protection outcomes

children.name: Outcome 3.1 By 2021, populations in vulnerable situations have improved health, nutrition, education, water and sanitation, and social protection outcomes
3.1.1 Targeted population have improved access to and use of quality preventive and curative health and nutrition services
3.1.2 Targeted population have improved access to/and use of safe and adequate WASH services
3.1.3 Equitable access to quality education is improved for school-aged children and youths

3.1.4 National and sub-national government partners have strengthened institutional capacities to develop and deliver child and women-sensitive social protection, particularly to children and families in the most-vulnerable situations

framework.name: Strategic Priority 4 - Governance, Rule of Law and Institutional Capacity Development
framework.description: By 2021, national, state and local institutions are more effective to carry out their mandates efficiently including strengthened normative frameworks that respect human rights and fundamental freedoms and ensure effective service delivery

children.name: Outcome 4.1 By 2021, national, state and local institutions are more effective to carry out their mandates efficiently including strengthened normative frameworks that respect human rights and fundamental freedoms and ensure effective service delivery

4.1.1 Justice institutions and administrative bodies are strengthened to provide equitable, effective and accountable justice services, and fair and transparent asylum procedures,  and communities and vulnerable groups, including asylum seekers,  enjoy enhanced access to justice and asylum procedures, and are empowered to demand respect for their human rights
4.1.2 Government institutions have enhanced capacities to consolidate the rule of law according to international norms and standards

4.1.3 National and state institutions have strengthened capacities in strategic operations for evidence-based planning, budgeting, implementation, monitoring and accountability for reduction of inequalities

framework.name: Strategic Priority 5 - Community Stabilization
framework.description: By 2021, community security and stabilization of people affected by conflict is improved through utilization of effective conflict management mechanisms, peace dividends and support  peaceful coexistence and social cohesion.

children.name: Outcome 5.1 By 2021, community security and stabilization of people affected by conflict is improved through utilization of effective conflict management mechanisms, peace dividends and support to peace infrastructures and durable solutions that augment peaceful coexistence and social cohesion
5.1.1 Targeted communities benefit from enhanced socioeconomic peace dividends* and durable solutions
5.1.2 Conflict resolution mechanisms, initiatives and networks are strengthened at community and state level
5.1.3 Government has increased capacities to develop national frameworks, policies, strategies and action plans on issues supporting peace building and durable solutions
